hits.title: The Farmer Companies Raises $17M, Names Dot's Pretzels Veteran CEO | C-Store News
hits.snippet: Burlington, Vt.-based The Farmer Companies has closed a $17 million Series A financing and appointed Randy Johnson as chief executive officer, positioning the premium cheese snacking platform for national scale behind its WHISPS and Cabot Creamery Popcorn brands. Founder Adam Farmer steps into a Chairman role, retaining board influence while handing day-to-day operations to Johnson. ... The round was led by Raff Ventures, the direct private investment arm of Rafferty Holdings, with participation from AJAX Capital Partners. Proceeds will fund manufacturing partnerships, national distribution buildout, and potential follow-on acquisitions, according to the company. ... The infusion of $17 million in growth capital, paired with a CEO whose prior company commanded a $1.2 billion exit, signals The Farmer Companies intends to push distribution aggressively. hits.snippet: BURLINGTON, Vt. — The Farmer Companies has announced the appointment of Randy Johnson as Chief Executive Officer, succeeding founder Adam Farmer, who will remain active as Chairman. Johnson joins the company following this month’s closing of a $17 million Series A financing led by Raff Ventures, alongside AJAX Capital Partners, as The Farmer Companies accelerates its strategy to build North America’s leading cheese snacking business through its ownership of WHISPS® and exclusive licensing partnership with Cabot Creamery. ... The Farmer Companies’ premium cheese snacking portfolio includes WHISPS, the iconic 100% cheese crisp brand, and an exclusive licensing partnership with Cabot Creamery to produce Cabot Creamery Popcorn, the fastest-growing popcorn brand in U.S. Food among the top 13 brands tracked by NielsenIQ. Both brands are built on the same foundation: award-winning cheese, premium ingredients, and exceptional flavor. Proceeds from the Series A financing will support continued investment in manufacturing partnerships, national distribution, and strategic acquisitions.

A new chapter begins! Today, The Farmer Companies announced the appointment of Randy Johnson as Chief Executive Officer and the successful close of a $17 million Series A financing. Randy's track record speaks for itself. He helped transform Dot's Pretzels into one of the fastest-growing brands in snacking, leading the business from $19 million to $250 million in annual sales before its acquisition by Hershey. His experience building brands, developing teams, and scaling businesses makes him the ideal leader for our next chapter. At The Farmer Companies, we're building a portfolio of exceptional food brands through acquisitions and strategic partnerships, with a primary focus on becoming the leader in premium cheese snacking. We believe the category is still in its early innings, and we're excited about the opportunities ahead to bring consumers innovative, high-quality products from some of the world's most iconic brands. We're grateful to our employees, customers, retail partners, suppliers, investors, and everyone who has believed in our vision. Your support has made this milestone possible, and we're excited for what comes next. Please join us in welcoming Randy to The Farmer Companies! https://lnkd.in/eBxqXfsF
